passage:
The student council noticed that students used hundreds of paper cups every week. Most cups were used for only a few minutes and then thrown away.
They started a "Bring Your Cup" week. Students who brought their own cups got a small sticker. Classes with the most stickers could choose music for lunchtime on Friday.
At first, some students forgot. Then friends reminded each other. By Wednesday, many bags had cups hanging from the side.
At the end of the week, the cafeteria used less than half the usual number of paper cups.
The council knew one week would not solve all waste problems. But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.
